name: pre-read-after-a-readers-failed-post-edit-is-fresh
description: A failed-edit report from a session that holds no write grant changes nothing (#513). Session A reads notes.md (v1), so it is a reader, and then reports a failed edit of notes.md (post-edit with success:false and no content_hash) without ever having been granted the write, as after a pre-edit that went unanswered. A stays a reader, and its next Read is fresh. Before, the report demoted A's read to INVALID and this read was denied on every retry. Both backends.
